'''Marc Thery''' (also published as '''Marc Thiery''') is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Paris Grand Slam]] on 15 April 2000 with [[You Can Either Profit By This... / Or Be Destroyed|You can either profit]], according to Tony Petersson's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d933">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-paris-france-15-4-00d933/ paris-france-15-4-00], DeckTech (Tony "Rogue22" Petersson, 25 June 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-06-25-paris-france-15-4-00d933/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
